name: 脉脉
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=脉脉
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = open.taou.com, h3.open.taou.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/(h3\.)?open\.taou\.com\/maimai\/adshow\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/(h3\.)?open\.taou\.com\/maimai\/pay\/v5\/check_gift\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/(h3\.)?open\.taou\.com\/maimai\/go_gossip_darwin\/external\/v2\/query_flow_cards\?/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/(h3\.)?open\.taou\.com\/maimai\/feed\/v6\/detail_recommend_feeds\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/maimai/maimai_ads.js") with enable=${mdmd_enable}, tag="脉脉帖子末尾", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/(h3\.)?open\.taou\.com\/maimai\/(feed|gossip)\/v\d\/(focus_feed|gossip_detail_comment|feed_detail_comment?)\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/maimai/maimai_ads.js") with enable=${mdmd_enable}, tag="脉脉", timeout=60, requires_body=true
